Senate Bill 72-2025

AN ACT REVISING PROVISIONS GOVERNING THE FILLING OF A VACANCY FOR CERTAIN MUNICIPAL ELECTIVE OFFICES; REVISING THE PROCEDURE FOR ENACTING ORDINANCE; REVISING PROVISIONS GOVERNING THE SALE AND DISPOSITION OF REAL PROPERTY; AND PROVIDING FOR OTHER MATTERS PROPERLY RELATING THERETO

Ordinance No. 4171

Adopted 8/18/26

AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF HENDERSON, NEVADA, TO AMEND TITLE 19 OF THE HENDERSON MUNICIPAL CODE – HENDERSON DEVELOPMENT CODE – TO MAKE NECESSARY CORRECTIONS, REVISIONS, AND UPDATES TO VARIOUS CHAPTERS INCLUDING RESIDENTIAL ZONING DISTRICTS, OVERLAY DISTRICTS, USE REGULATIONS, GENERAL SITE AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS, LANDSCAPE STANDARDS, PARKING AND LOADING STANDARDS, SIGNS, COMPREHENSIVE PLAN AND ZONING AMENDMENTS, CONDITIONAL USE PERMITS, DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENTS, AND DEFINITIONS OF TERMS.

Adopted 8/18/26

AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF HENDERSON, NEVADA, TO AMEND CHAPTER 4.72 – MOBILE FOOD VENDORS – OF THE HENDERSON MUNICIPAL CODE AND MATTERS PROPERLY RELATED THERETO.
